subject: Investor briefing: slide freeze, data appendix, and escalation path
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Investor briefing: slide freeze, data appendix, and escalation path

Team — attaching v3 of the investor briefing for the Orchard call (Q4 update). We're on a tight timeline: the board pack is being circulated externally next Tuesday; I need a slide-freeze decision by end of week so IR can start printing and the Board Secretary can package materials.

Two specific asks:
- Content sign-off: Are there any factual changes needed on the product / GTM slides? If so, flag the exact slide and the one-line correction.
- Financials & appendix: Vivek — the operational appendix (attached) has a couple of new metrics (deploy latency percentiles, Dedicated capacity uplift). Can you confirm the numbers or route to finance?

Notes: Claire (Orchard) shared redlines in a separate PDF — I attached the ones we received. Laura & Lauren, please confirm: if you have editorial feedback, send in-line comments on the Drive link or as brief bullets in reply. If we cannot reconcile a contentious slide by Friday 5pm PT, we should escalate to CEO for arbitration — include escalation path in replies.

Attachments: 2028_Q4_investor_briefing_v3.pptx; Q4_operational_appendix.xlsx; orchard_redlines_v1.pdf

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Corporate Strategy, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Investor briefing: slide freeze, data appendix, and escalation path

Jordan — quick pass from product/ops: overall looks tight and clear. Two small items:
- Slide 8 (Throughput/latency chart): label needs to state "p50/p95/p99, 99th computed on production sampling" — this is an ask from benchmarking team.
- Slide 12 (Roadmap bullets): remove the line "multi‑cloud private preview" — it's premature for public board pack; move to internal roadmap appendix.

If those are updated, approve from my side. For escalation: if there is a disagreement on the roadmap phrasing, loop in CEO and Solutions VP — but I think editorial change is sufficient.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Investor briefing: slide freeze, data appendix, and escalation path

Thanks Jordan — I reviewed slides 2–7 (market & GTM):
- Suggest tightening the TAM slide language: change "addressable" to "targeted" and add one bullet with the 2027 estimated ARR for the segment (quick stat).
- On the customer logo slide, remove one customer logo that still has an unresolved NDAs clearance (I flagged it in the Drive comments).

I can take the TAM language rewrite and the logo cleanup. Approve pending those two edits.

— Lauren
Director, Corporate Communications

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 11:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Investor briefing: slide freeze, data appendix, and escalation path

Jordan / team — I reviewed the appendix. Quick notes:
- The numbers in Q4_operational_appendix.xlsx are run-against-prod; CFO asked for finance-verified figures for the board. I'm looping in Markus to confirm.
- The "Dedicated capacity uplift" line used the projection model M-ops-v2; finance wants the conservative scenario (M-ops-v1) for the external pack. I've attached a one-line redline suggestion in the Drive (see related link).

If Markus can confirm by Friday EOD PT, we'll ship the conservative numbers. If he can't, escalate routing: we push the appendix with an "internal data note" and mark those lines as "subject to finance verification" — but I'd prefer a clean ship.

Vivek
SVP, Finance and Operations

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Investor briefing: slide freeze, data appendix, and escalation path

On Fri, Jan 13, 2028 at 03:12 PM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jordan / team — I reviewed the appendix. Quick notes:
> - The numbers in Q4_operational_appendix.xlsx are run-against-prod; CFO asked for finance-verified figures for the board. I'm looping in Markus to confirm.
> - The "Dedicated capacity uplift" line used the projection model M-ops-v2; finance wants the conservative scenario (M-ops-v1) for the external pack. I've attached a one-line redline suggestion in the Drive (see related link).

Vivek — confirmed. I ran the reconciliation this morning and switched the figures to the conservative projection. No material change to messaging; numbers now match finance ledger (spreadsheet tab: "board_trim").

Action taken:
- Updated Q4_operational_appendix.xlsx (tab: board_trim).
- Inserted conservative Dedicated capacity uplift figures in slide 18 and added a footnote: "Finance-verified, conservative projection".

Approve from finance. If there are additional adjustments, note them now — otherwise Jordan please proceed with external circulation.

Markus Klein
Head of FP&A

From: Board Secretary <board-secretary@orchardvc.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Investor briefing: slide freeze, data appendix, and escalation path

Jordan — received the finalized pack and the conservative appendix. Thank you for the quick turnaround. Two small items from our side:
- Please provide a one-paragraph CEO note (for the cover memo) by EOD tomorrow.
- We will circulate the pack to board members on Wednesday morning. If any last-minute redlines come from board members, route them to board-secretary@orchardvc.com with subject prefix "BoardRedline:" so we can track.

I'll confirm once the packet is out.

Best,
Claire Dyson (on behalf of Orchard Capital Board Secretariat)
Board Secretary — Orchard Capital
